command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
printf 'd2486ce56820f8d1992f894ed305cc572610ec9253a9520cce8902453c99944f  interp.py\n' > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u /tmp/interp.py /tmp/data/plasmid.fastq.gz > /tmp/out/interp.txt 2>&1
cat /tmp/out/interp.txt
grep -q 'INTERP OK' /tmp/out/interp.txt || exit 1
